study.notes: STUDY: GLORY-2, double blind placebo controlled phase 3 trial (NCT06164873, 27 Chinese hospitals, December 2023 to November 2025) of once weekly mazdutide 9 mg (dose_mg 9 per weekly injection) vs placebo, 2:1, in Chinese adults with obesity (BMI 28 or more by Chinese criteria, 16.1 percent with type 2 diabetes), 60 week treatment period then 12 weeks off treatment; 462 randomised, 461 treated and analysed (307 mazdutide, 154 placebo, primary analysis set); Table 2 gives least squares mean changes per arm and the between group difference with 95 percent CI under the treatment policy estimand at week 60 (route ci_95); SBP in mmHg (MD), triglycerides and LDL cholesterol as percent change (PCT); the other cardiometabolic markers (diastolic pressure, hsCRP, HbA1c, fasting glucose, fasting insulin, HOMA-IR, ALT, AST, total cholesterol, HDL, UACR) are in eTables 3 and 4 of Supplement 3, not in the packet (supplement pass pending); key secondary outcomes with type I error control (prespecified TRUE); pct_weight_change is the Table 2 between group difference in percent weight change, minus 15.15 (95 percent CI minus 17.22 to minus 13.09; arms minus 16.65 vs minus 1.50); sponsored by Innovent (industry_funded TRUE); rob_overall low

rows.notes: Table 2: change in systolic blood pressure from baseline to week 60, mm Hg, between group difference (treatment policy estimand); arms minus 9.80 (minus 11.37 to minus 8.23) vs minus 0.23 (minus 2.13 to 1.67); Table 1 baseline 122.7 (11.7) and 121.2 (11.2)

Table 2: change in triglycerides level, percent, between group difference at week 60; arms minus 21.06 (minus 36.73 to minus 5.40) vs 15.76 (3.03 to 28.49); Table 1 baseline 170.7 (98.3) and 150.5 (87.6) mg/dL

Table 2: change in LDL cholesterol level, percent, between group difference at week 60; arms minus 6.94 (minus 12.90 to minus 0.98) vs 3.15 (minus 2.09 to 8.40); Table 1 baseline 117.6 (28.8) and 119.7 (26.8) mg/dL

json.design: GLORY-2, double blind placebo controlled phase 3 trial, mazdutide 9 mg weekly vs placebo 2:1, Chinese adults with obesity, 461 analysed, 60 weeks
json.reason: full text group (institutional route); three inventory markers with between group differences and 95 percent CI in Table 2; nine further inventory markers are in the JAMA supplement eTables 3 and 4 (supplement pass pending)
biomarkers_reported_no_variance: DBP, hsCRP, HbA1c, fasting_glucose, fasting_insulin, HOMA_IR, ALT, AST, TC (stated as improved vs placebo at week 60 for both estimands; values in eTables 3 and 4 of Supplement 3, not in the packet)
liver_fat_pdff (79 participants with steatosis: liver fat reduced by more than 60 percent at weeks 24 and 60, eFigure 7; no contrast printed)
lean_mass (DXA subset of 90: total lean mass reduction 6.3 kg SD 3.9 vs 0.4 kg SD 2.6, eFigure 6; subset n per arm not printed)
other_markers: waist, hip, neck and arm circumference

rob.justification: interactive web response randomisation with stratification and block size 6 (D1 low); double blind with a treatment policy estimand (D2 low); primary analysis set of all treated participants with multiple imputation under the estimand framework (D3 low); laboratory and blinded measurements (D4 low); registered trial with key secondary outcomes under type I error control (D5 low)
